selection.aggregation: Average over the five splits within each configuration, then average configurations equally.
selection.v4_weighting: Count the five prespecified V4 graph seeds as five separate configurations, each with the same weight as any other configuration.
selection.default_if_either_condition_fails: Retain the reference without any secondary selection.

calibration.scope: All 21 configurations, including six ML configurations.

de_budget.scope: All and only configurations that actually use DE.
de_budget.initialization: For each split and configuration, use the same deterministic initialization and DE seed as the reference run. Keep the objective, inputs, solver settings, and software versions fixed.
de_budget.trajectory_check: Before comparing Val results, verify that the candidate reproduces the reference best-objective sequence for generations 1 through 120, ignoring elapsed time. If verification fails, stop the budget comparison and diagnose the mismatch before selection.

test.reporting: Exploratory re-evaluation on previously evaluated test partitions.
